key_insight: An SDRG-guided variational circuit corrects renormalization approximations for the two-dimensional random transverse field Ising model on quantum hardware.
engineering_relevance: Renormalization-group structure provides a route to shallow, hardware-compatible circuits for disordered quantum many-body simulations.
method: Adapt the emergent-coupling-based ansatz to the two-dimensional random transverse field Ising model.
Use the SDRG flow to determine quantum circuit structure.
Optimize circuit parameters to capture correlations beyond the SDRG approximation.
evidence_signal: Numerical and IQM superconducting-processor evaluations report relative energy accuracies of 89% for 16 qubits with full hardware optimization and 97% for 49 qubits using pre-optimized parameters.
watch_item: The 49-qubit result uses pre-optimized parameters, so full variational optimization on hardware at that scale remains un demonstrated.
paper_title: Variational Corrections to Strong-Disorder Renormalization in the Two-Dimensional Random Transverse Field Ising Model on Quantum Hardware
